Most families aren't overwhelmed by tasks — they're overwhelmed by the constant knowing, remembering, and anticipating that lives in someone's head. FamilyOps maps that weight: who carries what, where it accumulates, and how to find relief. It doesn't track chores. It doesn't rank partners. It reveals structure — so families can finally see their life, share it, and make it lighter. Together.

records.name: Eternal Flux
records.tagline: Same video, different mood. Track how you change
records.description: Eternal Flux helps you see how your internal ‘filter’ shifts across the day. Watch a short clip from your library, then watch the same clip again later. The app compares your reactions side-by-side and highlights the moments that changed, so you can spot patterns like overload, tension, or flattened reactions. Everything stays on your phone. No uploads. No server.

records.name: PrivMinds
records.tagline: AI desktop apps that never touch the cloud
records.description: PrivMinds is a suite of 3 desktop apps for professionals who need AI but can't risk their data. 🔒 MasterMind - Document intelligence & AI templates 📧 MailMind - Email & calendar assistant 🎙️ RecordMind - Meeting transcription in minutes Unlike ChatGPT, Otter.ai, or other cloud tools, PrivMinds runs 100% locally on your computer. ✅ No cloud uploads ✅ No API keys required ✅ Works with Ollama, LM Studio, or any local AI ✅ Perfect for healthcare, legal, finance Your data never leave your device

records.name: Vezert
records.tagline: High-conversion websites built with UX and AI
records.description: Vezert helps startups and growing businesses launch high-conversion websites without unnecessary complexity. We design and build landing pages, corporate websites, and web portals with a strong focus on UX, speed, and real business results. By combining proven design frameworks with AI-enhanced development, teams can move faster from idea to launch — without sacrificing quality. Vezert is best suited for companies that treat their website as a growth tool, not just a visual asset.

records.name: AI Chrome Extension Builder
records.tagline: Build Chrome Extensions by Talking to AI
records.description: Prompt AI to build complete Chrome Extensions. Give instructions in plain English and AI designs, codes, writes your privacy policy and creates a Chrome Web Store listing for you. Anyone can become an extension developer without knowing how to code.

records.name: Invofox 2.0
records.tagline: Document AI for real-world workflows, not just demos
records.description: Invofox 2.0 is a platform-level update focused on production-grade document parsing. While most document AI tools look accurate in demos, they struggle with messy, real-world inputs. This launch highlights a structured experimentation workflow that makes field- and document-level accuracy visible before production, helping teams understand accuracy changes, validate improvements, and confidently deploy reliable document workflows.

records.name: How High-Accuracy Data Labeling Improved
records.tagline: Ai data services
records.description: Achieve reliable AI outcomes with high-accuracy data labeling. Expert annotators, multi-level reviews, and consistent quality at scale.

records.name: Meteroid
records.tagline: Billing platform to launch, test, + scale business models
records.description: Meteroid is a monetization platform built so early-stage teams can ship like they're already at scale: ✅ One engine for subscriptions, usage-based pricing, quote-to-cash, invoicing and business intelligence ✅ Support any Go-to-Market motion ✅ Open-source (not open core) and extendable. Self-host it or let us run it. Either way, it’s yours. 🚀

records.name: Meet-Ting
records.tagline: AI that gives your schedule a brain.
records.description: Ting gives your schedule a brain, so it can make decisions for you. It’s an AI availability agent that manages your calendar over email and text. You set your goals and preferences, and Ting learns your patterns every time you CC or message it, building AI intuition over time. Delegate Ting to plan meetings with up to five guests, handling booking, rescheduling, pre-call briefs, and no-shows. Each week, Ting proactively checks in to help align your calendar with what you want to achieve.

records.name: Fundable
records.tagline: Integrate startup, investor and people data in your product
records.description: Fundable is a startup, investor, and people dataset (like a Crunchbase) with a few improvements: Surfaces new deals before other platforms, provides sources for every datapoint, allows for natural language deal alerts ("coding agent startups in SF looking to hire"), much better UI, cheaper. First month is free. Hit us up if you want access to our API, Datafeed, or MCP!

records.name: Fluent
records.tagline: Agentic AI in Any Mac App. Now with Native RAG
records.description: This time, Fluent is supercharged by MCP and a native RAG engine, and it's a real game-changer. Beyond its general purpose, RAG lets you replicate your writing style almost 100%. This launch is mostly about that: write like yourself, write like Jack London, write like the world's top marketers. And never be accused of AI slop. To put it simple – Fluent RAG is the cornerstone of generating instead of writing.

records.name: Steel Man Resumes: Truth. Told Strong.
records.tagline: Paste your shitty resume. Get a whole job search strategy."
records.description: Got a shit resume and a complicated past? Paste it into The Forge. Our AI analyzes your experience and spits back a Career Intelligence Report — strengths, gaps, how to frame the hard stuff, local employers hiring now. Completely free. Want documents? The Refinery ($37) generates your resume, cover letter, portfolio page, 50 matched employers, application tracker, interview scripts, wage negotiation guide, and 30-day action plan. Built for blue-collar workers and second-chance candidates.

records.name: Willow on Windows
records.tagline: Write anywhere on your computer. By voice.
records.description: You write hundreds of messages, emails, and prompts a day. Willow is an AI voice typing tool that lets you speak them instead. Willow now works on Windows, Mac, and iOS. You can use it anywhere on your computer, like Gmail, Slack, Notion, Cursor, and more. Willow is powerful because it's the fastest, most accurate, and the only dictation tool that actually personalizes to the way that you write over time.

records.name: Camu – Unified Digital Campus Platform
records.tagline: Student Information System for Colleges and Universities
records.description: Camu is a unified Student Information System (SIS) platform designed for universities and higher education institutions managing complex academic operations. We helps centralize student data, automate admissions, manage academic workflows, and enable real-time governance—without relying on disconnected systems.

records.name: SnapSafe
records.tagline: The camera that minds it's own business
records.description: SnapSafe: Privacy-first camera app keeping every photo on YOUR device. - Fully encrypted local storage, zero internet permission, no trackers/ads/analytics. - Auto-strip metadata, blur faces, control GPS tags. - PIN-locked gallery - Poison pill (fake PIN wipes photos) and decoy photo support. - Share safely. - 100% free & open source.

records.name: QRVid.app
records.tagline: The simplest way to attach video to the real world.
records.description: I love making physical photo albums of my kids, but a still photo never quite captured their laughter or first steps. I tried adding videos via QR codes, but the process was a nightmare: uploading to clouds, managing links, and expired URLs. It took hours. I built QRVid.app to fix this. Now, it takes seconds. Upload your video, get a beautiful QR code, and stick it in your album. No tech headaches, just memories that actually move when you scan them.

records.name: Ktzchen Web3
records.tagline: Web3 tools for token deployment and auditing
records.description: Ktzchen Web3 provides professional Web3 tools focused on Ethereum API access and multi-chain smart contract deployment. The platform offers secure Ethereum API keys, real-time metrics, smart contract auditing, and contract deployment across 39 blockchain networks, built for developers, founders, and Web3 builders.

records.name: AQIproc
records.tagline: Know Your Air. Breathe Everywhere
records.description: AQIproc helps you understand the air you breathe in real time. With automatic location detection, city search, and detailed insights into pollutants, it shows how air quality affects your health. Designed for clarity and comfort, AQIproc empowers you to make safer daily choices, wherever you are.

records.name: TravelAnimator
records.tagline: Turn Google Maps URLs into stunning map animations.
records.description: TravelAnimator turns Google Maps URLs into travel map videos in seconds. It stands out with 250+ 3D vehicle models, 30+ map styles, 4K and HD exports, the ability to add photos to routes, and a completely ad-free experience. Built for travelers, creators, and storytellers who want their journeys to look as good as they felt, without spending hours editing.

records.name: Mondo
records.tagline: Your smart guide to city events & must-see attractions
records.description: Traveling to a new city but short on time? Mondo helps you instantly discover the best attractions and major events in Europe’s top cities. Add them to your calendar, plan your trip in seconds and get personalized recommendations. It’s just as useful at home—discover concerts, exhibitions and festivals happening near you. The more you use Mondo, the smarter it gets, learning your interests and recommending events tailored to your favorite categories. Less planning. More experiences.

records.name: Pandada AI
records.tagline: Build data wealth: Turns files into McKinsey-level insights
records.description: Pandada empowers both non-technical operators and data scientists to achieve data wealth. Move beyond "chatting" with data—Pandada turn messy csvs, pdfs, excels files, and even photos into downloadable and shareable McKinsey-level reports and presentations — so you can make better decisions grounded in data.

records.name: Outcome AI
records.tagline: We read & analyze your dashboards so you don’t have to.
records.description: Outcome AI is your product decision copilot. We pick up where your team left off — your tools, your context, your work — and help you decide what to build next and why. No blank pages. No busywork. Just clarity so your product team can focus on building and creating.

records.name: Nestling
records.tagline: Smart baby sleep tracker and personalised AI coach
records.description: Baby tracking apps are stressful. Notifications, busy screens, data overload – they add chaos, not calm. Nestling is different. Free, simple tracking (one-touch, Siri, Watch, Lock Screen) with an optional AI coach that can directly analyse your logged data – personalised sleep advice without copying logs into chats. No ads. No marketing emails. Privacy-first. Built by a paediatrician dad who wanted tracking that helps, not overwhelms.

records.name: ADPS: Access Table Structure Exporter
records.tagline: From Access table structure  to txt, json or SQL create
records.description: Releasing my fist pro Access DB export product. Acces Database Pro Scipts (ADPS) can be ran from your Access DB wihout external toling.

records.name: howToCSV
records.tagline: Even if you hate CSV, you'll love this
records.description: HowToCSV - Data Analysis Tools for CSV and Excel: suite of tools designed to help you clean, transform, visualize, and analyze your data with ease. Just upload your CSV or Excel files! All in browser and made to speed up boring spreadsheet things

records.name: Chrono Rift The Last Day
records.tagline: A turn-based roguelike RPG where every decision matters.
records.description: "I built this game without writing a single line of code." I'm Jinsu, a non-dev. Using Vibe Coding (AI co-pilot), I built this SF Roguelite in 4 weeks. Chrono Rift features: Time = Life: Currency is your HP. Deep Randomness: Probability logic creates infinite replayability. Skill QTEs: Combat adds physical tension to strategy. AI handled the code; I handled the soul. Play Web Version: https://rift-server.vercel.app/ Experience the desperation of Time Collapse.

records.name: DRS Solution AutoCAD DWG Converter
records.tagline: Precision conversion for AutoCAD professionals.
records.description: Streamline your CAD workflow with the DRS AutoCAD DWG Converter, a powerful tool designed for fast and accurate file transformation. Whether you're converting DWG, DXF, or DWF files to PDF, images, or older CAD versions, it preserves every layer and geometry with precision.Enjoy batch processing to handle large projects instantly—all without needing an expensive AutoCAD license. It’s the reliable, standalone solution for pros who need seamless data migration and zero downtime.

records.name: RealEstatePro
records.tagline: property management boost sales with smart automation.
records.description: High-performance real estate platform for modern agencies. Manage leads, properties, and pipelines with ease. Smart lead tracking, automated follow-ups, all-in-one dashboard, mobile-friendly design, and CRM/social integrations. Quick onboarding lets agents start managing listings instantly. More than a tool—it’s a complete, efficient workflow solution.

records.name: UdduLinguaShift
records.tagline: Translate any website instantly, without switching tabs
records.description: Instantly translate any website into your preferred language with a single click

records.name: STEMSPLITTER
records.tagline: Pro stem separation for $5 once, not $20/month
records.description: Stemplitter uses Demucs AI to separate vocals, drums, bass, and instruments from any audio file. Upload a song or paste a YouTube/SoundCloud link, get studio-quality stems in minutes. Why Stemplitter: ∙ $5 one-time payment vs $20/month subscriptions ∙ 3 free tries to test quality ∙ Handles hi-res audio (24-bit/192kHz) ∙ Fast processing (6 minutes for complex tracks) ∙ No account required If you’re a producer, drummer learning songs, or creator sampling audio - this is for you.

records.name: Pyraman DMS Secure Document Management
records.tagline: Document Management System
records.description: Pyraman DMS is a secure document management and control software that centralizes files, automates version control, approvals, and access rights. Improve compliance, reduce document risks, and streamline collaboration with audit-ready document control built for modern businesses.
